title: Por más que + subjuntivo: aunque, sin importar cuánto

sections.content: Por más que (no matter how much, however much) is an emphatic concession -- it grants that something happens or is true to a great degree, and still insists the main clause holds anyway. It's typically followed by the subjunctive, since it frames the conceded fact as something that, however true, doesn't change the outcome.

items.spanish: Por más que cambiaran los modelos de desarrollo a lo largo del siglo, la desigualdad social siguió siendo el problema estructural sin resolver de la región.
items.english: However much development models changed throughout the century, social inequality remained the region's unresolved structural problem.

items.spanish: Por más que crecieran las economías nacionales durante la década, ese crecimiento por sí solo no bastó para reducir de forma significativa la desigualdad.
items.english: However much national economies grew during the decade, that growth alone was not enough to significantly reduce inequality.

items.spanish: Por más que el propio Levy reconociera que ningún diseño experimental podía capturar por completo la complejidad de la pobreza rural mexicana.
items.english: However much Levy himself acknowledged that no experimental design could fully capture the complexity of Mexican rural poverty.

items.spanish: Por más que los resultados en asistencia escolar y salud infantil fueran alentadores, la desigualdad estructural de la región exigiría mucho más que un solo programa.
items.english: However encouraging the results in school attendance and child health were, the region's structural inequality would demand much more than a single program.

sections.content: Por más que always takes the subjunctive when it concedes a fact this way, unlike aunque, which can take the indicative for facts the speaker treats as simply true. Por mucho que works the same way and is fully interchangeable.
